Comment.Language: For the Commemoration of Archangel Raphael:

Text.Language: Marenouwst m~V~iwt nem P~s/ri nem Pip~neuma e#y#u#: n~tentaio~ n~Rava/l pimahsomt n~ar,/aggeloc.
Let worship the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, and honor Rafael the third in archangels.
فلنسجد للآب والإبن والروح القدس ونكرم رافائيل الثالث فى رؤساء الملائكة.
